title: 第417章 玄瑶 主人给的实在太多了第416章 一日入金仙
content_zh:
第一卷第417章玄瑶：主人给的实在太多了
禁地深处。
楚枫从炼天图中踏出，腰间的传信玉符便微微震动了一下。
“主人，我……我可以进来吗？”
楚枫没有回答，只是翻手取出禁地令牌，指尖在令牌上轻轻一点。
一道光芒射向禁地入口的屏障，那道光幕裂开一道只容一人通过的缝隙。
玄瑶早就等在禁地外，看到屏障打开的瞬间便闪身而入。
当她看到谷底的场景之时，整个人都僵在了原地。
楚枫头顶上空悬浮的那片宝物海洋，让她根本挪不开眼。
功法玉简、仙器法宝，如同满天繁星悬浮在虚空中，散发出令人窒息的宝光。
此刻它们就这样毫无遮掩地悬浮在玄瑶面前，将整片谷底都映照得如同传说中的仙家宝库。
玄瑶的瞳孔剧烈收缩，红唇微微张开，喉咙里发出一声压抑不住的惊呼。
她知道楚枫和司冥音扫荡了夜叉族的宝库，可她从未亲眼见过这般景象。
“这些都是两族的镇族至宝……”
楚枫看着玄瑶下巴都快惊掉的模样，只是随手指向头顶的宝物。
“喜欢什么，自己拿。”
直到此刻，玄瑶才从宝物的震撼中回过神来，这才注意到楚枫周身那股磅礴到令人窒息的威压，那是金仙境的威压。
她的主人在短短一夜之间，从玄仙六重直接突破到了金仙九重，横跨了整整十二重小境界。
她修行这么多年，从未听过有人能在这么短的时间内突破这么多境界，便是传说中那些上古天骄也做不到。
玄瑶双腿一软，直接跪在了地上，声音因激动而微微发颤。

“恭喜主人突破到金仙境！”
然后她抬起头，目光再次投向那片宝物海洋，喉咙微微滚动了一下。
那些宝物每一件都让她心跳加速，随便拿出一件都足以让她的实力翻上数倍。
“真的可以吗？”
楚枫眼中闪过一丝戏谑，随机伸出三根手指。
“我只数三个数。”
闻言，玄瑶再也不敢犹豫。
她知道主人的脾气，说一不二，她若还不选，那就什么都得不到了。
她飞身而起，却没有扑向那些宝物，而是轻盈地落在楚枫身旁，双手捧住他的脸颊，踮起脚尖，在他的侧脸上轻轻吻了一下。
她的唇瓣微微发颤，脸颊绯红如霞。
“谢谢主人。”
但随着一阵香风飘过，玄瑶转身飞向那片宝物海洋，玉手抓向了一直心心念念的那样宝物。
那是一柄通体幽紫的软剑，剑身只有两指宽，薄如蝉翼，柔若柳枝。
罗刹幽影剑！
这是罗刹族一位老祖的本命仙器，传闻此剑可融入持有者的影子之中，出剑时无声无息。
此剑在万年前随着那位老祖一同消失，罗刹族始终都没找到，没想到竟被夜叉族夺去藏在了宝库之中。
她将罗刹幽影剑捧在掌心，剑身感受到她的罗刹血脉，自动发出一声清越的剑鸣。
她只取了一样东西便不再多看其他宝物一眼，重新落回楚枫身旁。
“我选这把剑。”
楚枫看着她这副克制的模样，反而满意地点了点头。

面对满天宝物却能克制贪念，只取自己最需要的一件。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 417 Xuanyao: The master gave me too much
Deep in the forbidden area.
Chu Feng stepped out of the Heaven Refining Diagram, and the message jade talisman around his waist vibrated slightly.
"Master, I...can I come in?"
Chu Feng did not answer, but turned his hand and took out the forbidden land token, and tapped it lightly with his fingertips.
A ray of light shot towards the barrier at the entrance to the forbidden area, and the light curtain cracked a gap that only allowed one person to pass through.
Xuanyao had been waiting outside the forbidden area for a long time, and when he saw the barrier opened, he rushed in.
When she saw the scene at the bottom of the valley, her whole body froze in place.
The ocean of treasures suspended above Chu Feng's head made it impossible for her to move her eyes away.
The Jade Slips of Kung Fu Techniques and Immortal Artifacts and Magical Treasures are like stars floating in the sky, emitting a suffocating precious light.
At this moment, they were suspended in front of Xuanyao without any cover, reflecting the entire valley floor like the legendary treasure house of the Immortal Family.
Xuanyao's pupils contracted violently, her red lips opened slightly, and she let out an uncontrollable exclamation in her throat.
She knew that Chu Feng and Si Mingyin had raided the Yaksha clan's treasure house, but she had never seen such a scene with her own eyes.
"These are the treasures of both clans..."
Chu Feng looked at Xuan Yao's jaw that was about to drop in shock, and just pointed at the treasure above his head.
"Get whatever you like."
It was only at this moment that Xuanyao recovered from the shock of the treasure, and then noticed the majestic and suffocating pressure around Chu Feng, which was the pressure of the Golden Fairy Realm.
In just one night, her master broke through from the sixth level of the Mysterious Immortal to the ninth level of the Golden Immortal, spanning twelve entire minor realms.
She has been practicing for so many years, but she has never heard of anyone being able to break through so many realms in such a short period of time. Even the legendary ancient geniuses couldn't do it.
Xuan Yao's legs softened and she knelt directly on the ground, her voice trembling slightly with excitement.
"Congratulations, master, for breaking through to the Golden Fairyland!"
Then she raised her head, looked at the ocean of treasures again, and her throat rolled slightly.
Each of those treasures made her heart beat faster, and taking out any one of them was enough to increase her strength several times.
"Is it really okay?"
A hint of joking flashed in Chu Feng's eyes, and he randomly stretched out three fingers.
"I'm just counting to three."
Hearing this, Xuanyao no longer dared to hesitate.
She knew her master's temper, and if she didn't choose, she would get nothing.
She flew up, but did not pounce on the treasures. Instead, she landed lightly next to Chu Feng. She held his cheeks with both hands, stood on tiptoes, and kissed the side of his face gently.
Her lips trembled slightly, and her cheeks were as red as a blush.
"Thank you, Master."
But as a gust of fragrant wind drifted by, Xuanyao turned around and flew towards the sea of treasures, and grabbed the treasure that she had been thinking about with her jade hands.
It was a soft purple sword with a blade only two fingers wide, as thin as a cicada's wing and as soft as a willow branch.
Rakshasa Shadow Sword!
This is the natal weapon of an ancestor of the Rakshasa tribe. It is said that this sword can blend into the shadow of the holder, making no sound when the sword is drawn.
This sword disappeared with the ancestor ten thousand years ago, and the Rakshasa clan never found it. Unexpectedly, it was taken away by the Yasha clan and hidden in the treasure house.
She held the Rakshasa Shadow Sword in the palm of her hand. The sword felt her Rakshasa bloodline and automatically made a clear sword cry.
She only took one thing and no longer looked at the other treasures, and returned to Chu Feng's side.
"I choose this sword."
Chu Feng looked at her restrained look and nodded with satisfaction.
Faced with treasures all over the sky, he can restrain his greed and only take the one he needs most.
